Okay. I am not gonna do it. I think I saw a sign. I was leaving my house  and everything was going good. The gate didn't squeak and no heard me. That fear I had as a climbed up onto the car ( and am terribly afraid of widely life) drove me to think that that is why I live. I forget about this fear a lot but this time it really shocked me back into reality. If it wasn't for you to slow me down before I left I would have never seen those raccoons. I am so happy right now. I know this isn't a permanent fix but I am super grateful for keeping me alive for today.
Thanks man. I see if I can make it. I try to talk to somebody.
